kerala.breakfast.egg-and-vegetable-omele.name: Egg & Vegetable Omelette
kerala.breakfast.egg-and-vegetable-omele.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 2 eggs whisked with diced beans, tomatoes, onions, green chillies
steps: Finely dice the beans, tomato, onion and green chilli.
Whisk the eggs with the vegetables, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, pour in the mix and cook on medium until set, then flip and finish for a minute.
Toast the wholemeal bread dry and serve alongside the omelette.

kerala.breakfast.egg-bhurji-and-multigra.name: Egg Bhurji & Multigrain Toast
kerala.breakfast.egg-bhurji-and-multigra.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 2 eggs scrambled with French beans, carrots & pepper
steps: Finely chop the beans, carrot, capsicum, onion and green chilli.
Saute the vegetables in the oil for 3-4 minutes with turmeric and salt until just tender.
Pour in the whisked eggs and scramble on low heat, breaking into soft curds; finish with pepper.
Toast the wholemeal bread dry and serve with the bhurji on top.

kerala.breakfast.idli-swap-oats-rava-idl.name: Idli Swap: Oats-Rava Idli & Sambar
steps: Pressure-cook the toor dal with turmeric until soft and mash.
Dry-roast the oats and rava, grind the oats coarsely and mix both with yoghurt, grated carrot, salt and enough water to a thick batter; rest 10 minutes.
Simmer the diced onion, tomato, beans and half the carrot in tamarind water with coriander and chilli powders, then add the dal and cook 5 minutes.
Temper coconut oil with mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida and pour over the sambar.
Steam the batter in greased idli plates for 10-12 minutes; makes 2-3 idlis.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the idlis and a bowl of sambar.

kerala.breakfast.lace-appam-and-egg-roas.name: Lace Appam & Egg Roast
components: 1 egg roast with thick shallot-tomato gravy (do not drink plain coconut milk)
steps: The night before, blend the rice flour with coconut, yeast, a teaspoon of sugar, salt and water to a thin batter and leave to ferment.
Hard-boil the egg, peel and halve.
Heat coconut oil, pop mustard seeds and curry leaves, then saute sliced shallots, ginger, garlic and chilli until deep golden.
Add the spice powders and tomato and cook down to a thick gravy; fold in the egg and simmer 2 minutes.
Swirl ladles of batter in a hot appachatti to make 2 lace appams with thin crisp edges; cover and cook until the centre is set.
Serve strictly 2 appams with the egg roast; no extra coconut milk on the side.

kerala.breakfast.oats-puttu-and-cherupay.name: Oats Puttu & Cherupayar
steps: Soak the green gram overnight (or 4 hours).
Pressure-cook the soaked green gram with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles until just tender.
Temper coconut oil with mustard seeds, dried red chilli and curry leaves; saute shallots, garlic and green chilli.
Stir in the cooked green gram with a little stock and the coconut; simmer 5 minutes to a loose curry.
Pulse the oats coarsely, moisten with salted water and steam in the puttu kutti with a layer of coconut for 5-7 minutes.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the oats puttu and 3/4 cup of curry.

kerala.breakfast.pesarattu-and-boiled-eg.name: Pesarattu & Boiled Egg
steps: Grind the overnight-soaked whole green gram with ginger, green chilli, cumin and salt to a smooth batter.
Grind the coconut, coriander, shallots and tamarind with a pinch of salt into a thick chammanthi.
Spread the batter thinly into 2 pesarattus on a hot tawa, top with chopped onion, drizzle oil and cook both sides until crisp.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the pesarattus and 1 tablespoon of chammanthi.

kerala.breakfast.pesarattu-and-chutney.name: Pesarattu (Moong Dosa) & Chutney
steps: Grind the overnight-soaked whole green gram with ginger, green chilli, cumin and salt to a smooth batter.
Grind the coconut, coriander, mint, shallots and tamarind into a thick chammanthi.
Spread the batter thinly into 2 dosas on a hot tawa, scatter chopped onion, drizzle oil and cook both sides.
Hard-boil the egg (10 minutes), peel and halve. Serve with the dosas and 2 tablespoons of chammanthi.

kerala.dinner.cheera-parippu-and-egg-phu.name: Cheera Parippu & Egg Phulka
steps: Knead the atta with warm water and a pinch of salt; rest while the dal cooks.
Pressure-cook the toor dal with turmeric and 300 ml water for 3 whistles.
Add the chopped cheera, garlic and green chilli to the dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Grind the coconut with cumin, stir into the dal and bring back to a boil.
Heat the coconut oil, pop the mustard seeds with the dried chilli, shallots and curry leaves, and pour over the dal.
Roll two thin phulkas and cook on a hot tawa, puffing them over the flame.
Beat the egg with pepper and salt and cook a thin single-egg omelette.
Serve the phulkas with a bowl of cheera parippu and the omelette.

kerala.dinner.cherupayar-porridge-and-bo.name: Cherupayar Porridge & Boiled Eggs
kerala.dinner.cherupayar-porridge-and-bo.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 1 large bowl savoury Cherupayar soup/puzhukku with crushed cumin
steps: Soak the green gram for 30 minutes if you have time, then pressure-cook with turmeric and 400 ml water until very soft.
Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Crush the cumin, garlic and green chilli together and stir into the hot gram.
Mash lightly so it becomes a thick soupy porridge; add salt and the grated coconut.
Heat the coconut oil and fry the shallots and curry leaves until golden; pour over the porridge.
Serve a large bowl of porridge with the eggs sprinkled with black pepper.

kerala.dinner.cherupayar-puzhukku.name: Cherupayar Puzhukku (No Rice Dinner)
components: 1.5 cups Cherupayar puzhukku with 1 tbsp fresh coconut
steps: Pressure-cook the green gram with turmeric and salt until soft but still whole.
Hard-boil the eggs, peel and keep only the whites.
Crush the coconut with cumin, garlic and green chilli; stir into the gram and cook until dry.
Temper mustard seeds, shallots and curry leaves in the coconut oil and fold into the puzhukku.
Simmer the carrot, beans and cabbage with ginger and pepper in water for 10 minutes for a clear soup.
Serve the puzhukku with the egg whites and a bowl of soup.

kerala.dinner.fish-tikka-and-sambar-soup.name: Fish Tikka & Sambar Soup
components: 150g grilled fish fillet cubes (Neymeen or Hamour) marinated in spices
1 large bowl clear drumstick vegetable sambar (no rice)
steps: Marinate the fish cubes in kashmiri chilli, turmeric, ginger, garlic, pepper, lime juice and salt.
Pressure-cook the toor dal soft; soak the tamarind and squeeze out the pulp.
Simmer the drumstick, ash gourd and brinjal in the tamarind water with coriander, chilli powder and turmeric until tender.
Add the mashed dal, thin with water to a soupy consistency and simmer 5 minutes.
Temper mustard, fenugreek, dried chilli, asafoetida, shallots and curry leaves in coconut oil and pour over the sambar.
Knead the atta, roll one chapati and cook on the tawa.
Pan-grill the fish cubes in the oil for 3 minutes a side and serve with the sambar soup and chapati.
kerala.dinner.fish-tikka-and-sambar-soup.swapNote: Fish fillet can be Neymeen, Kalava, or Basa.

kerala.dinner.muttai-roast-and-french-be.name: Muttai Roast & French Beans
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Fry the sliced onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in the oil until golden brown.
Add chilli, coriander and turmeric powders with a splash of water and cook to a thick onion masala.
Add the eggs, coat in the masala, finish with garam masala and cook 2 minutes.
Saute the chopped French beans with shallots, pepper and salt until just tender.
Roll one chapati, cook on the tawa and serve with the egg roast and beans.

kerala.dinner.muttai-roast-and-steamed-c.name: Muttai Roast & Steamed Cabbage
kerala.dinner.muttai-roast-and-steamed-c.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 1 large bowl steamed cabbage with black pepper
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Fry the sliced onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in the oil until golden.
Add the spice powders and chopped tomato and cook to a thick masala.
Add the eggs, coat well, finish with garam masala and cook 2 minutes.
Steam the shredded cabbage 5 minutes and toss with black pepper and salt.
Roll one chapati, cook on the tawa and serve with the egg roast and cabbage.

kerala.dinner.tandoori-pan-grilled-chick.name: Tandoori/Pan-Grilled Chicken & Beans
steps: Marinate the chicken in yoghurt, kashmiri chilli, garam masala, coriander, ginger, garlic, lime juice and salt for 15 minutes.
Knead the atta, roll one small chapati and cook on the tawa.
Pop the mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, curry leaves and the chopped beans with turmeric and salt; cover and cook 8 minutes.
Stir in the coconut crushed with cumin and green chilli and cook until dry.
Pan-grill the chicken in the oil on medium heat 6 minutes a side until charred and cooked through.
Rest, slice and serve with the beans thoran and chapati.

kerala.lunch.ayala-tawa-sear-and-cheera-.name: Ayala Tawa Sear & Cheera Thoran
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the mackerel with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Heat 1 tsp coconut oil on a tawa and sear the fish 4-5 min per side with curry leaves until the skin is crisp and the flesh flakes.

Strip and wash the leaves for the cheera thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.
Whisk the yoghurt with water, crushed ginger, green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make the sambharam; chill until serving.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the cheera thoran, the mackerel, and the sambharam alongside.

kerala.lunch.chemmeen-ularthiyathu-and-p.name: Chemmeen Ularthiyathu & Pavakka
kerala.lunch.chemmeen-ularthiyathu-and-p.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 150g Chemmeen (Prawns) sautéed with shallots, curry leaves, and cracked pepper
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the prawns with turmeric, chilli powder and salt.
Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in coconut oil, add the prawns and crushed black pepper, and toss 5-6 min until dry and coated.

Dice the vegetable finely for the pavakka mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.
For the moru kachiyathu, whisk yoghurt with water and turmeric, warm gently without boiling, and temper with mustard seeds, fenugreek, shallots, ginger, green chilli, dried chilli and curry leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the pavakka mezhukkupuratti, the prawns, and the moru kachiyathu alongside.

kerala.lunch.chicken-pepper-roast-and-mu.name: Chicken Pepper Roast & Murungayila
kerala.lunch.chicken-pepper-roast-and-mu.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: 1 cup Chicken pepper roast (dry preparation with shallots)
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the chicken with turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt for 15 min.
Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in coconut oil, add the chicken and cook covered 15 min, then uncover, add crushed black pepper and garam masala and roast until dry and dark.

Strip and wash the leaves for the murungayila thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra tomato) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the murungayila thoran, the chicken, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.kalava-curry-and-kovakka.name: Kalava (Grouper) Curry & Kovakka
kerala.lunch.kalava-curry-and-kovakka.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 1 portion Kalava (Reef Cod/Grouper) stewed with turmeric, ginger, and Kudampuli
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Clean the grouper fillet; soak the kudampuli in warm water and grind the chilli powders, turmeric and a little water to a paste.

Heat coconut oil in a clay pot, splutter fenugreek seeds, sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves, add the chilli paste, the kudampuli with its water and salt, then slide in the fish and simmer 12-15 min until the gravy thickens.

Dice the vegetable finely for the kovakka mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra black pepper) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the kovakka mezhukkupuratti, the grouper fillet, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.karimeen-pollichathu-and-ch.name: Karimeen Pollichathu & Cheera
kerala.lunch.karimeen-pollichathu-and-ch.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 1 whole Karimeen (Pearl Spot) roasted in banana leaf with spicy shallots
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Score and marinate the pearl spot with turmeric, chilli powder, pepper, lime juice and salt, then sear briefly on both sides in 1 tsp coconut oil.
Fry shallots, ginger, garlic and green chilli in the remaining oil, add tomato, chilli powders and curry leaves and cook to a thick masala.
Wilt the banana leaf over a flame, spread masala on it, lay the fish on top, cover with more masala, wrap, and roast the parcel on a tawa 8-10 min per side.

Strip and wash the leaves for the cheera thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra tomato) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the cheera thoran, the pearl spot, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.mathi-roast-and-padavalanga.name: Mathi Roast & Padavalanga Thoran
kerala.lunch.mathi-roast-and-padavalanga.kidNote: Hold back the green chilli and chilli powder for the child's portion.
components: Primary: 3 fresh sardines (Mathi) pan-seared with turmeric, pepper, Kudampuli
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Marinate the sardines with turmeric, chilli powder, crushed pepper, lime juice and salt for 15 min.
Heat 1 tsp coconut oil on a tawa and sear the fish 4-5 min per side with curry leaves until the skin is crisp and the flesh flakes.

Dice the vegetable finely for the padavalanga thoran; splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil, add shallots and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, cover and cook until just tender, and finish with grated coconut.

For the rasam, simmer tamarind water with crushed tomato, garlic, pepper, cumin, turmeric and salt (extra cumin) for 10 min, temper with mustard seeds, dried chilli and asafoetida, and add coriander leaves.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the padavalanga thoran, the sardines, and the rasam alongside.

kerala.lunch.nadan-kozhi-stew-and-french.name: Nadan Kozhi Stew & French Beans
components: 1 bowl Nadan chicken stew cooked in thin coconut milk with ginger, carrots, and whole spices (No mutton)
steps: Rinse the matta rice, pressure-cook it with 3 cups water for 5 whistles (or boil 35 min) and drain.
Sauté cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, onion, ginger and green chilli in coconut oil without browning.
Add the chicken, carrot, pepper, salt and 1.5 cups water, cook covered 25 min, then add the coconut milk and curry leaves and simmer gently 5 min.

Dice the vegetable finely for the french beans mezhukkupuratti; splutter mustard seeds in coconut oil, add shallots, garlic and green chilli, then the vegetable with turmeric and salt, and stir-fry uncovered until tender and lightly browned.
Whisk the yoghurt with water, crushed ginger, green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make the sambharam; chill until serving.
Plate 1 level cup rice with the french beans mezhukkupuratti, the chicken, and the sambharam alongside.

kerala.snack.green-tea-and-roasted-makha.name: Green tea & Roasted makhana spiced with turmeric & salt
components: 1 cup roasted makhana (foxnuts) spiced with turmeric & salt
steps: Steep the green tea bag in a cup of just-boiled water for 3 minutes, then remove the bag.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan, add the makhana and roast on low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until crisp.
Sprinkle with turmeric and salt, toss well and serve with the green tea.

kerala.snack.hot-kattan-chaya-and-boiled.name: Hot Kattan Chaya & Boiled sprouted green gram
steps: Boil a cup of water, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes, strain and serve unsweetened.
Steam or simmer the pre-sprouted green gram for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Drain, season with salt and serve warm with the tea.

kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-kadala-sun.name: Kattan Chaya & Kadala sundal
steps: Boil a cup of water, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes, strain and serve unsweetened.
Heat the coconut oil, pop the mustard seeds, then add the curry leaves and dried red chilli.
Toss in the pre-boiled kadala with salt and heat through for 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in the grated coconut, take off the heat and serve warm with the tea.

kerala.snack.kattan-chaya-and-roasted-pe.name: Kattan Chaya & Roasted peanuts or almonds
steps: Boil a cup of water, add the tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes, strain and serve unsweetened.
Dry-roast the peanuts and almonds in a pan for 3 to 4 minutes until fragrant.
Serve the nuts warm with the tea.

kerala.snack.sambharam-and-walnut-halves.name: Sambharam & Walnut halves
steps: Whisk the yoghurt with 150 ml cold water, crushed ginger, slit green chilli, curry leaves and salt to make sambharam.
Break the walnut halves into a small bowl; toast briefly in a dry pan if you prefer them warm.
Serve the walnuts with the chilled sambharam.

kerala.snack.spiced-inji-chaya-and-boile.name: Spiced Inji chaya & Boiled white chana
steps: Crush the ginger and cardamom, boil them with the pepper in a cup of water for 2 minutes, add the tea leaves, simmer a minute and strain.
Reheat the pre-boiled chickpeas in a pan with a splash of water for 3 to 4 minutes.
Season with salt and serve warm with the drink.

kerala.snack.spiced-sambharam-with-crush.name: Spiced Sambharam with crushed curry leaves & Roasted almonds
components: 1 glass spiced Sambharam with crushed curry leaves
steps: Crush the curry leaves, ginger and green chilli with the cumin, then whisk into the yoghurt with 150 ml cold water and salt.
Dry-roast the almonds in a pan for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant and let them cool.
Serve the almonds alongside the drink.
